text: I'd like to write a review to suggest improvements to the clinic's hygiene practices. While the dentist and staff are of good standard, what I find completely unacceptable is the way the medical gloves are used. During my most recent visit (and this has happened twice now with different dentists), I observed the dentist picking up gloves that had been left on the equipment tray. After putting them on and preparing for the procedure, I could clearly smell a foul odor of saliva/bad breath. Brand new gloves shouldn't smell like that. After the procedure, I saw them remove the gloves and place them back on the tray instead of immediately disposing of them in the trash. This greatly risks the spread of infectious diseases. I would like the clinic to be more stringent in changing gloves for each patient for the safety of all patients. I honestly feel unsafe when I go for dental treatment now. However, because I appreciate the other aspects of the service and want to continue treatment here, I'd like to ask the clinic to address this issue for the peace of mind of all patients.
